sources.detail: All 6 registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 196-343 KB decompressed (r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted - it is IP-403 on this host; sizes read off disk because curl's size_download reports the COMPRESSED length). <style> blocks stripped BEFORE parsing since the tier-list CSS ships inline, and the <table class="tier-list"> count asserted at EXACTLY 1 per page. Letter taken from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster. Counts reconciled BEFORE any merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40 and M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, every letter inside the registered 7-band icyveins scale. 11 letters moved, all M+, and two of them are last night's literal TBD rows closing rather than movement: Windwalker Monk null -> S and Frost Death Knight null -> A+. The other nine: Demonology Warlock A+ -> S+, Beast Mastery Hunter A -> A+, Feral Druid A -> A+, Mistweaver Monk A -> A+, Holy Priest B -> A, Survival Hunter B -> A, Discipline Priest C -> B, Destruction Warlock A+ -> A, Marksmanship Hunter A -> B. All three M+ pages were re-cut yesterday (dateModified 2026-08-30 15:31 / 13:48 / 12:46 UTC) - the DPS page about fifteen minutes AFTER last night's fetch, which is why last night saw none of it. published re-read per page from JSON-LD dateModified and written: raid 08-23 / 08-24 / 08-08, M+ 08-30 / 08-30 / 08-30. Era: every page self-identifies as Season 2 and carries Devourer in the DPS lists; the raid-HEALER page title still reads "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" while its section heading reads "Midnight Healer Tier List for Season 2" and the body says Season 2 21 times, so body-over-title applies and seasonVerified stays s2. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run.

Both registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 165 KB decompressed. Parsed from the tier__tier / tier__title / data-original-title markup, resolved by ROSTER MATCH rather than by container position, which is what correctly rejects the M+ page's second tierlist: its eight entries are dungeon-difficulty blocks (King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs) and none maps to a spec. Counts reconciled before merging: raid 40 unique of 40 rows across S/A/B/C, M+ 40 unique of 40, 0 unmatched. ZERO letters moved in either bracket. The pages' own "Last Updated" lines are unchanged at 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+), which is the honest explanation for a static parse; the snapshot advances because we fetched today, the page dates do not. Era: both self-identify as Midnight Season 2 (raid explicitly "This Midnight Season 2 Raiding tier list for The Venomous Abyss Raid"), no Season 1 string anywhere, Devourer present. seasonVerified stays s2.

All 6 registered pages fetched with the full browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB decompressed; r.jina.ai deliberately NOT tried, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Parse per the recorded recipe: unescape \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST, then find the [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] block (never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml, the raid-healer page carries a decoy call), segment on [tier-label ...]X[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, and resolve each [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug against the roster. Exactly one tier-list block per page. Counts reconciled before merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40, M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched slugs, 0 duplicate-tier conflicts, all letters inside the registered 7-band wowhead scale. 3 letters moved, all on the raid-HEALER page, which is the only page dated today (dateModified 2026-08-31T11:20:18-05:00): Discipline Priest S -> A, Holy Priest B -> A, Holy Paladin A -> B. Every other page is byte-identical to last night. published re-read per page and written: raid 08-14 / 08-31 / 08-14, M+ 08-28 / 08-26 / 08-18. Era: all six titles self-identify as Midnight Season 2 and Devourer is present in both DPS lists. seasonVerified stays s2.

Not reachable - the site-wide human-verification wall for a NINTH consecutive night. All 12 registered archon.gg pages were fetched individually with the full browser header set (UA, Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua, Sec-Fetch-*, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests); all 12 returned HTTP 403 with a ~6.1 KB Cloudflare managed-challenge body ("Just a moment...", cType: 'managed', /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/) and __NEXT_DATA__ count 0. Asserted on __NEXT_DATA__ presence, not the status code, per the contract note. NOTE FOR THE OWNER: the wall now has TWO shapes and they are IP-dependent - the 2026-08-31 LOCAL run recorded HTTP 200 with a ~2.5 KB verification body from a residential IP, while CI still gets the 403; either way __NEXT_DATA__ is absent, so behaviour is unchanged. No solve, replay or automation was attempted and nothing was backfilled from Warcraft Logs (hard rule 3). Stored letters, numbers and snapshots left byte-identical; consensus stays Icy Veins + Method + Wowhead.

Two plain curls, no headers, no proxy, no auth: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json HTTP 200 -> snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39Z), and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 161,191 bytes, Last-Modified 'Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT' - the two dates AGREE, which is what distinguishes this from the 08-04 case. Selection applied as specified: 44 blocks, whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined = 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee/ranged deliberately excluded as dps subsets). 0 of 40 lowerBound values moved against stored. Nothing merged, so the coverage date correctly does not advance. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED standing red from the contract label: do not ack it away, it clears when WoWMeta re-runs.

Fetched cleanly, upstream has still NOT re-cut, so nothing was merged and the stored date correctly does not advance. Plain browser-UA GET on all three meta pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 40-71 KB. Each page's own <time datetime> reads 2026-08-28T03:00:31Z / 03:00:28Z / 03:00:31Z - three days stale on a page that advertises an 8-hour refresh cadence, and identical to the stored asOf. All 40 rows re-parsed and diffed anyway: 27 DPS / 7 healer / 6 tank, 0 values moved, 0 nulls. PARSER TRAP WORTH RECORDING: murlok's <a> attribute ORDER is not stable - most rows are <a class="vi-box meta-item ..." href=...> but some are <a href=... class="vi-box meta-item ...">, and a regex anchored on the class-first form silently dropped 4 of 40 rows (Arms Warrior, Beast Mastery Hunter, Restoration Druid, Protection Paladin), one per page plus one, presenting exactly as if those specs had left the page. Caught only by reconciling 25/6/5 against the 27/7/6 roster shape before merging. Split on '<a [^>]*class="vi-box meta-item' instead.

HELD WHOLESALE for a sixth night - a DELIBERATE HOLD, not a fetch failure - but the blocking picture CHANGED and the owner should know. All 27 DPS charts requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 3 retries each: 22 now return real payloads carrying simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart, never hard-coded; chart timestamp 2026-08-29), up from 19 last night as Arms and Fury re-simmed. 5 still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry: Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, Retribution Paladin. Against 26 stored MID1 profiles at 2026-07-08/07-15, wholesale adoption of the 22 would now drop 26 -> 22 rows = 15.4%, which is INSIDE maxRowDropPct 0.25 - that objection was 27% and blocking last night and is now gone. What still blocks it is the value move: 114 of the 132 overlapping target rows move more than 60% (MID2/MID1 ratio min 1.152, median 1.870, max 2.833), which trips maxValueMovePct 0.6, and that gate has no agent-writable proposal channel - only a human value_move_ack re-run or a reviewed local run can land it. The tier-uniformity invariant also still forbids a pool holding both MID1 and MID2. Nothing merged; fightProfile.asOf stays each chart's OWN timestamp rather than the run date, so the coverage date correctly does not move and the staleness IS the honest signal. Expected to clear together with simulationcraft, which is blocked on exactly the same five specs.

HELD for a sixth night; the blocker is still maxValueMovePct, but TWO upstream facts moved and both cut against the contract label's current wording. (1) MID2_Raid.txt is 1.29 MB, Last-Modified 2026-08-31T07:27:24Z, header '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-08-29/69497, git build HEAD 3b891e639e)', with a real DPS Ranking: block that now maps to 22 of 27 DPS specs (up from 19; absent: Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution - the same five Bloodmallet is missing). Wholesale adoption would drop 26 -> 22 stored rows = 15.4%, INSIDE maxRowDropPct 0.25, so the coverage objection recorded in the contract row no longer holds. (2) MID1_Raid.txt is now 272 BYTES (Last-Modified 2026-08-31T07:05:26Z) - an in-progress run with no ranking block at all - and its header reads the SAME build as MID2, so MID1 has stopped being the 12.0.7 artefact the label describes AND has stopped being readable as a fallback. What still blocks adoption: all 22 overlap rows move more than 60% (MID2/MID1 ratio min 1.692, median 1.997, max 2.351), so maxValueMovePct fires and needs the human value_move_ack. Nothing merged; the stored 26 rows and their 2026-08-08 date are byte-identical.

Fetched cleanly; the period has NOT advanced since last night's merge, so nothing was merged and the stored date correctly does not move. /period/latest HTTP 200, 198 KB, 302-resolving to period 1078 as it did last night, and the subtitle is character-for-character identical: 'Period 1078, week 2 of MID2 ... Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters (2833 unique), 17.2 average key level'. Parse bounded to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section (scanning the whole page would pick up the Classes-and-specs block and the per-dungeon sections and yield ~59 rows): 39 rows, labels normalised on [-\s]+ with whitespace-tolerant number matching. Sanity-checked before any merge decision - series sum 100.20 with role subtotals DPS 60.10 / Tank 20.10 / Healer 20.00 and the page's own ranged/melee/tank/healer subtitles reading 30.3 / 29.8 / 20 / 20, i.e. the representation share and not the /meta per-key-presence column. All 39 values equal the stored ones. Frost Mage remains absent upstream (legitimate zero representation, not a parse failure) and keeps its stored 0 at 2026-08-27.

The Sept 1 post itself was re-read at version 3 (topic 2342331 via the bare /t/<id>.json form - the slug form 301s to an empty body) and all 15 stored highlights match it line for line, so no re-log and no tierSet change is owed. All 44 transcribable channels with a channelId polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each = 660 videos, media:description parsed alongside each title. Distilled: LBNinja7 pdYpGLyZ7VM -> 3 healer takes (Mistweaver, Restoration Druid, Discipline Priest); Kalamazi z_dKoGx_FIk -> 5 Warlock takes (Demonology raid+M+, Affliction raid+M+, Destruction M+); YoDaTV xYXkZA1L490 -> 7 in-scope M+ tank/Paladin/Warrior takes. izen bDElWkJxvtY -> 24 metaNotes in the general-creator lane, never takes. 15 same-creator/same-spec/same-lens takes and 20 izen metaNotes superseded; cross-lens pairs left live. Three judgment calls recorded in log.md: YoDaTV's apparent Retribution move was declined because the ASR reads 'Brett's most recent buffs' and the referent cannot be pinned; LBNinja7's 'holy's in a good spot' (Holy PALADIN, not Priest) and 'no Shaman changes' asides were not logged, since no-change remarks would have clobbered substantive 08-15 takes at the same lens; and izen's opening enumeration of specs 'whose players might have been sweating' was dropped per the list-mention rule.
